subject: MapleCity AI Summit — Sponsorship package & speaking slot details
messages:
From: Nicole Park <nicole@maplecityevents.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: MapleCity AI Summit — sponsorship options

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the quick intro — excited to explore having Redwood Inference at MapleCity AI Summit (May 18-19, 2026). Attached is our sponsorship prospectus with package levels and deliverables. Quick highlights for the Platinum package: primary logo placement on stage backdrop, 20-minute speaking/demo slot on the main track, 10x10 booth near the entrance, lead retrieval, and three VIP passes.

Would you be available for a 20-minute call next week to walk through the prospectus and confirm whether the main-stage speaking slot is important to you?

Attachment: MapleCity_Sponsorship_Prospectus_2026.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)

Thanks,
Nicole Park
Partnerships Lead
MapleCity Events
ops@maplecityevents.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Park <nicole@maplecityevents.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MapleCity AI Summit — sponsorship options

Nicole — thanks, the prospectus looks good at a glance. We're interested in a Platinum package but I need a few clarifications before we lock number and sign: 

- Logo placement: what does "primary" mean exactly? Size and exact placement on the stage backdrop and website banner (screenshot examples appreciated).
- Speaking slot: we prefer a 20-minute product demo + customer case study on the main track (not a panel). Can you confirm that can be guaranteed versus a breakout?
- Lead retrieval: timing and format (CSV, fields included), and any privacy opt-in constraints.
- Booth: can we request adjacency to the entrance or keynote hall?
- Hotel + comps: are there discounted room blocks and comps for speakers?
- Contract/payment: draft agreement and payment terms (NET30 typical for us) — can you share a draft?

Looping in Ava (Field Marketing) for logistics and Ben (VP Partnerships) for commercial. If we can get main track confirmation and mobile app splash placement (in-app splash on day 1), we can move quickly.

I can do a short call tomorrow at 10:30 PT — or send the answers over email if easier.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Nicole Park <nicole@maplecityevents.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MapleCity AI Summit — sponsorship options

Thanks Jordan — quick answers inline and attaching a draft agreement: 

- Logo placement: Platinum gets "primary" position: center-right on the stage backdrop (approx 18% width), top banner on the event website (desktop + mobile). We can also include the logo in the mobile app splash on day 1 as requested.
- Speaking slot: we can guarantee a 20-minute main track demo in Track A (morning slot on Day 1) for Platinum sponsors. We reserve the right to shift timing by up to 2 hours for program flow, but main stage status is guaranteed.
- Lead retrieval: CSV export with name, title, email, company, opt-in flag; delivered within 48 hours post-event. No scrubbed PII beyond opt-ins per our privacy policy.
- Booth: we'll reserve a 10x10 near the north entrance; map attached in the prospectus.
- Hotel & comps: 1 comp room for speakers + discounted block (15% off) at the partner hotel.
- Contract/payment: draft attached — we typically ask for NET30.

Attachment: Draft_Sponsorship_Agreement_MapleCityAI_20260220.pdf (PDF, 540 KB)

If those terms look good I can follow up with a revised agreement reflecting the mobile app splash and lead delivery timing.

Best,
Nicole

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Park <nicole@maplecityevents.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-25T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MapleCity AI Summit — sponsorship options (couple edits)

Nicole — appreciate the quick clarifications. A few small edits before we sign: 

1) Speaking slot: confirm that the 20-minute demo will include a 3–5 minute on-stage intro by the MC that calls out Redwood as the demo sponsor. That mention is important for our exec messaging.
2) Logo: please add our logo to the printed on-site program cover (in addition to backdrop and site).
3) Recording/distribution: we request that the session recording be provided to Redwood within 7 days and that MapleCity clear on-demand distribution to event partners (we just want explicit limits in the contract).
4) Lead retrieval: good with CSV, but we need the attendee opt-in boolean and session attendance flag (so we can attribute demo viewers).
5) Payment terms: our procurement cycle may need NET45 — is that possible? If not, NET30 is acceptable.
6) Pricing: the prospectus lists Platinum at $35,000. Given the edits above (program cover + recording), we'd like to do $30,000 for Platinum + pre-event email mention (one dedicated paragraph in the pre-event attendee email).

If you can update the agreement to reflect the above, we can get this routed internally and sign. Ava — can you flag any AV needs/concerns for the demo (I added you for logistics). Ben — FYI on the proposed $30k.

Thanks,
—Jordan

From: Nicole Park <nicole@maplecityevents.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MapleCity AI Summit — sponsorship (revised offer)

Jordan — great notes; we've updated the agreement and made the following concessions to close: 

- Pricing: revised Platinum fee to $32,000 (includes mobile app splash, program cover logo, pre-event attendee email paragraph, and the guaranteed 20-minute main-stage demo).
- Speaking slot: confirmed 20-minute demo on Track A, Day 1 morning; MC will do the 3-minute intro and mention Redwood as the demo sponsor.
- Recording: MapleCity will provide the session recording within 7 days and grants Redwood the right to distribute the recording for marketing purposes (non-exclusive).
- Lead retrieval: CSV with name/title/email/company/opt_in/session_attended delivered within 48 hours post-event.
- Booth + comps: 10x10 near entrance and one comp speaker room; hotel block details in the prospectus.
- Payment: NET30.

I've attached the revised agreement (v2) reflecting these items. If this looks good, please sign via DocuSign (link below) and we'll issue the final invoice.

Attachment: MapleCity_Sponsorship_Agreement_v2_20260303.pdf (PDF, 680 KB)
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/MapleCityAI-Sponsor-v2

Let me know if you need anything else.

Best,
Nicole Park
MapleCity Events

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Nicole Park <nicole@maplecityevents.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T08:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MapleCity AI Summit — sponsorship (final commercial terms)

Nicole — this is close. Thank you for the concessions and the quick turnaround on v2. Two final asks before we get procurement to sign off: 

1) Payment terms: we need NET45 to accommodate our PO process. We can accept NET30 if MapleCity needs that, but would request a one-time invoice issue that allows NET45. If you can issue the invoice to "Redwood Inference, Attn: AP" and include our PO number field (we'll submit PO once DocuSign is complete), we can typically make NET45 work.

2) AV logistics: we need confirmation that our demo will have a wired HDMI feed and an on-site AV tech for setup (15 min) and run-of-show coordination. Please add an AV clause or confirm by email.

If you update the DocuSign packet with the invoice payee name + NET45 request or confirm invoice flexibility, we'll sign. Otherwise we're prepared to accept NET30 and proceed immediately.

I'll wait for the updated DocuSign link; Ava — can you coordinate with the events team to capture any specific AV specs (Ben, FYI).

Thanks — Jordan
Director, Strategic Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com
(415) 555-0142
